chunks: We shall admit those who believe and do the right among the righteous.
ai.seo_question: What are the two conditions for being admitted among the righteous according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inseparable bond between faith and action, where 'Salihin' refers not only to prophets and martyrs but also to the righteous who emulate the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a divine promise that sincere belief, when manifested through practical piety, guarantees entry into the company of the truly successful, reinforcing the concept of 'Amal' as the fruit of 'Iman'.
